_note: Project-scoped .mcp.json for use without the plugin marketplace. Claude Code reads this when run inside the agentic-ai repo (or any project that copies this file and adjusts paths). All four MCP servers point to the unified TS / Rust outputs in packages/. Run `pnpm install && pnpm build` first so dist/ and target/release/ exist.

args: BIN="${PROJECT_DIR}/packages/codebase-rust/target/release/ai-architect-mcp" && if [ -x "$BIN" ]; then exec "$BIN"; else exec cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path "${PROJECT_DIR}/packages/codebase-rust/Cargo.toml"; fi
